title: Drag a watch on a chain: a tractrix
body: Huygens studied the curve traced by an object dragged on a taut leash when the puller walks a straight line, the tractrix, a pursuit where the rope stays tangent. Rotating it yields the pseudosphere, a surface of constant negative curvature that helped mathematicians believe non-Euclidean geometry. A dog-walk curve became a model universe with different parallels.
